steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 15-second explainer for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, from the "26-pay-per-job-vs-pro" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. serif hook rises line by line while ten job cards fly in and stack up with a live counter
2. pay-per-job receipt fills row by row and its total counts up; the Pro card's price per job drops with every row; a green banner says when Pro has paid for itself
3. the total is struck through; the Pro card turns into the blue 'What you get with Pro' tile
4. five feature cards with small UI illustrations appear one by one and get a check
5. dark slide: what a week without the job costs, counted up, against what Pro costs per day
6. checkout card builds line by line; its button grows until it fills the screen
7. blue end card: mark, wordmark with plan badge, two-line tagline, URL pill

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 26-pay-per-job-vs-pro my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,5,10,14`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: Money is formatted from cur + dec (use cur 'R$ ' and dec ',' for Brazilian reais). The receipt total is perJob x rows and the Pro line is monthly / rows, so keep perJob, monthly, the banner, the savings pill and the checkout copy consistent with each other: the defaults are $2.90 per job, $29 for 6 months ($4.83 a month), $7.29 month to month (34% more). The small UI inside the feature cards is drawn in the ILL array; its labels are English and not variables. Long lines shrink to fit their space.
